name: Starling Lab Capture-Store-Verify data integrity
basis_note: Only signal is Filecoin Foundation's September 2025 newsletter announcing the GSR co-funded cohort as 'already active'. It dates from the funding itself, so it says nothing about what happened afterwards.

name: EASIER Data geospatial data preservation
basis_note: Blog posts run to 8 Dec 2025 and repositories were updated to 20 Feb 2026, so the initiative is active. Work was merged into the Decentralized Geospatial Collaborative with Astral (1 Mar 2025). No signal shows wider routine use of the funded storage work.
michael_note: Row 14: Extended Pilot at Low Confidence

name: TRANSFER Data Trust artist-owned archive
basis_note: Open Collective ledger shows GSR Foundation funding since Feb 2026 and dated entries 'Project Management – Phase 2' (6 May 2026), 'Second Round Grant' (7 May 2026) and 'Data Trust Round 3' (17 Sep 2026). Same operator, further phases (codebook S1). Several dated entries agree, but all are in one source.

name: Akashic refugee digital memory archive
activity_signal: No repo activity since Apr 2024 (organisation active)
basis_note: Funding the Commons organisation is active (repositories updated Sep 2026), but the akashic repository was last updated 24 Apr 2024. Repository inactivity alone does not show the use case ended.

name: Oceanic Whispers marine data trust (CROSSLUCID/RadicalxChange/Serpentine)
basis_note: CROSSLUCID's current site (lists October 2026 events) states 'Oceanic Whispers (ecosystem) (upcoming 2026)'. An explicit operator statement that the work is not yet delivered; coded Pilot (protocol 'active pilot'). Mapping 'upcoming' to Pilot is an interpretation.

name: Relay Funder aid platform for displaced communities
basis_note: Relay Funder app is live and lists refugee-community projects in Kenya and Uganda. Undated; shows the platform operating, not wider routine use beyond the pilot.

name: Stablecoin for Impact (Launchnodes) yield to Giga school connectivity
basis_note: Launchnodes' 2026 site offers 'Impact Staking & Stablecoin For Good' to any social-impact project and names partners beyond Giga (UNICEF, UNHCR, Mercy Corps Ventures, GiveDirectly). Single indirect signal; it is a service offer and partner list, not evidence of routine use (codebook growth example: Low, human review).

name: Lido Impact Staking yield to MCV, UNICEF and Giga
activity_signal: No signal on the use case
basis_note: Lido H1 2026 report (first 8,000 characters held) does not mention Impact Staking, UNICEF, Giga or Mercy Corps. Absence from an excerpt is not evidence of status.

name: Celo stablecoin payments for digital microwork (youth)
basis_note: No status signal was held for this case.

name: Smart-contract weather index insurance (inX/Etherisc/ACRE Africa)
basis_note: Etherisc site timeline lists 'MVP for crop insurance in Kenya ready', first on-chain payments, and 'Next exciting chapter … Acre Africa crop insurance is now on Celo blockchain', with a 250,000-farmer aim. Entries are undated and may predate the packet documents.

name: DeFi merchant digitisation
basis_note: No status signal was held for this case.

name: DeFi salary advances / credit for smallholders
basis_note: Only signal is a Celo forum post of Oct 2022–Jan 2023 mentioning credit delegation with Mercy Corps Ventures 'with a forthcoming report'. It is contemporaneous with the pilot, not later.

name: Stablecoin buy-now-pay-later for MSMEs/informal vendors
basis_note: SympliFi's site offers supplier payments and 'Flex pay' for African SMEs with a Kenyan customer quote. The company and a buy-now-pay-later-type product are active, but the site does not mention stablecoins or blockchain, so continued use of the funded solution is not shown.

name: Forest Carbon Web3 carbon projects
basis_note: Forest Carbon's site describes carbon projects and makes no mention of blockchain or Web3; the MCV lab page lists only the pilot launch. Consistent with lesson S9 (pilot ended without blockchain), but the S9 source came from the pre-draw check, which protocol 6.3 excludes as a status code.
michael_note: Row 10: Confirm Unknown. Do not approve failure case wording.

name: Blockchain anticipatory cash transfers for pastoralists (pilot + scale-up 2025-26)
basis_note: No status signal was held for this case.

name: Haraka & Grameen Foundation onchain microfinance for VSLAs
basis_note: Founder's LinkedIn post (about 11 May 2026, from the post ID): 'In early March, we wound down Haraka.' Explicit statement that the organisation closed.

name: Anticipatory cash transfers for flood-prone areas
basis_note: Rumsan portfolio page describes the Nepal anticipatory-action deployment itself (four Terai municipalities, GSMA and FCDO support). Undated and describes the pilot, not what came after.

name: Anzi grain tokenisation and credit guarantees
activity_signal: Company scaling; no signal on Argentina grain pilot
basis_note: Anzi Finance is growing fast (39,200 guarantees in H1 2026, Uruguay launch, US$25M plan) with blockchain-tokenised guarantees, but its tokenised guarantee product predates the pilot (May 2024) and no signal covers grain tokenisation for Argentine smallholders after the pilot launch.

name: Aleo/Humanity Link privacy-preserving USDCx aid (with DRC)
basis_note: No status signal was held for this case.

name: OS City (blockchain government records/credentials)
basis_note: Article (URL dated 28 Sep 2026; text reads as an earlier Ethereum Foundation fellow update) says OS City rolled out an official citizen digital identity through a government-run portal, covering commercial and construction permits and tax statements. Single indirect signal; the text may predate the packet.

name: W3 Engineers TeleMesh blockchain-backed offline mesh messaging
basis_note: TeleMesh changelog's last release is 1.0.0 (20 Apr 2021); W3 Engineers' site lists the 'On/off-grid messaging platform on blockchain' among past projects with 2018–2020 posts. Signals point to dormancy, but no source says it ended.

name: BX Smart Labs smart-contract savings circles
basis_note: Bloinx documentation page reads 'Última actualización hace 2 años' (last updated two years ago). Single sign of low activity; no statement on status.

name: Kotani Pay transfers, savings and payments
basis_note: Kotani Pay's about page describes on/off-ramp infrastructure across Africa serving 'some of the top businesses in the world'. Single undated indirect signal of routine commercial operation of a blockchain payment product.

name: Rumsan Rahat cash and voucher assistance
basis_note: Rahat blog: after the first UNICEF investment the system was piloted with a Country Office, scope expanded in 2023 to financial access, and bridge funding followed. UNESCO Digital Innovation Hub page (current listing) presents Rahat as a modular platform with Anticipatory Action and Social Protection modules. Corroborated by the MCV-18 signal (Rahat used for anticipatory action with the Danish Red Cross in Nepal). Signals agree on further deployments for new clients.

name: Xcapit blockchain wealth management and financial learning
basis_note: No status signal was held for this case.

name: GovBlocks decentralised decision-making tools
basis_note: GovBlocks LinkedIn page gives a generic description (incubated at Somish, 2017) with no dated activity.

name: Grassroots Economics community currency / emergency payments
activity_signal: Organisation active; Celo data shown as historical to Jul 2025
basis_note: Grassroots Economics site is active (commitment pooling, CLC App, Kilifi hub) but labels the Celo data 'Historical Sarafu Network activity … 5 July 2023–20 July 2025'. The organisation continues; no signal states the status of the funded emergency-payments use.

name: Convexity CHATS cash and voucher platform
basis_note: Stellar Community Fund submission describes a further CHATS pilot with Mercy Corps Mauritania (USAID Nafoore) and plans with UNICEF country offices; chats.cash markets the platform to NGOs. A new client fits S1 'Scaled', but the submission is a plan, not proof of deployment.

name: WiiQare health-savings vouchers
basis_note: WiiQare's current site sells health passes (Pass santé, chronic-disease and second-opinion passes). The voucher product is live, but the site does not mention blockchain, so continued use of the funded solution is not shown.

name: Investtools blockchain resource-delivery marketplace
basis_note: Exame article says Investtools' GOV Token (public-spending tracking, with Finep/FAPERJ) moved to Blockchain Studio, a new company in the same group. This is a different product from the UNICEF/Giga resource-delivery marketplace.
